narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no pauses between sentences.

rose.instruct: Sweet young woman forcing a bright, wobbly smile while clearly hurt, quick and high.

amy.instruct: Warm, excited best friend, gushing and fast, then suddenly confused.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You forgot your Cancer friend's birthday and she says it's fine.

lines.speaker: rose
lines.text: It's totally fine!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She is smiling and it is not fine.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her name is Rose and she's warm and protective and a little soggy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She cries at weddings and cat videos and car insurance ads.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She remembers your birthday and your mom's and your dog's.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her home is the safest place in town.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Friends come over sad and leave with soup and a hug.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Rose, you're literally the best person alive!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Rose feels so loved and so needed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then Amy opens the hallway closet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An avalanche of boxes buries her to the neck.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every box has a date on it.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Is this my handwriting from ninth grade?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Rose dives for it and slips on her tissues.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What's going on inside a Cancer?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a crab shell with one tiny door that says safe people only.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside is a giant cabinet labelled FEELINGS.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every drawer is full and none of them close.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next to it, a tissue box with a counter.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Today it reads forty-one and it's only noon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the friend who forgot? Your drawer just opened.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Rose still makes you soup and salts it with tears.
